title: Park Bench Drop
description: Collect a dropped device containing high-value operational logs, on short notice.

hints: How many signed Brodney paintings are there on each floor of this house?
The first half of the code counts those in the basement plus those on the main floor.
The second half of the code counts those across the four upstairs bedrooms.

config.instruction: A patrol is sweeping the park. Ditch the device to slip past the checkpoint, or try to smuggle it out under the guard's nose?
You're clear of the park, and the device synced before you lost it. Take the calendar data, or grab the courier's laundered cash.
